Section 2. Base Salary and Performance Bonus.
The Company shall pay the Executive an initial annual base salary of $325,000, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices. The Executive shall also be eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus with a target amount equal to 40% of the Base Salary.

Section 3. Term and Termination.
The initial term of employment shall commence on January 1, 2024, and continue for a period of twenty-four (24) months. Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party.

Section 4. Non-Disparagement.
The Executive agrees that during the term of employment and for thirty-six (36) months thereafter, the Executive shall not make, publish, or communicate to any person or entity any defamatory, disparaging, or negative statements regarding the Company, its products, or its management.
